$comment: A canned PR against sample-target, used for local runs and to capture the demo recording. patch.diff is applied to the materialised sample-target repo to produce the PR branch.
title: Refactor Stripe event routing to a lookup table
prDescription: Replaces the growing switch in handleStripe with a route table keyed by event type. No behaviour change intended — same handlers, just dispatched from a map.

expectedFinding.summary: The route table key is "charge.refund"; Stripe sends "charge.refunded". Every Stripe refund now falls through to the ignore branch, still returns 200, and never debits the ledger.
